items.title: 阿曼拟与中国Hoymiles合作建设首座太阳能逆变器制造设施
items.title_en: Oman proposes its first solar inverter manufacturing facility with China's Hoymiles
items.summary: 阿曼投资局与中国Hoymiles、PCG Global及Greenwill Asset Management提出总值约1亿美元（约3845万阿曼里亚尔）的合作计划，涵盖太阳能项目开发及太阳能逆变器本地制造。计划不代表逆变器工厂已获EPC授标。
items.summary_en: Oman Investment Authority, China's Hoymiles, PCG Global and Greenwill Asset Management proposed a partnership valued at approximately USD100 million (around RO38.45 million) encompassing solar project development and the country's first dedicated solar inverter manufacturing facility. No EPC construction award has been confirmed.
items.why_it_matters: 中国新能源技术企业参与本地化制造，可形成工业厂房及设备供应的潜在合作。
items.why_it_matters_en: Chinese clean-energy technology participation could create local manufacturing and industrial equipment supply opportunities.
items.gci_opportunity: 跟进中国企业出海合作、工厂设计、设备采购及供应链本地化。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track Chinese outbound investment cooperation, plant design, equipment sourcing and supply-chain localisation.

items.title: 阿曼苏哈尔汽车与先进制造产业园签署约3800万里亚尔投资安排
items.title_en: Oman's Sohar Automotive and Advanced Industries Park signs land lease for approximately RO38 million investment
items.summary: 苏哈尔自由区11月8日签署六项土地租赁协议，合计计划投资逾6300万里亚尔、覆盖逾44万平方米。其中由EW Partners支持的Sohar Automotive & Advanced Industries Park拟投资约3800万里亚尔，项目用地约31.7万平方米，首期拟开发约18万平方米厂房、车间和仓库。3800万里亚尔包含于上述六项总额，不应重复相加。
items.summary_en: On 8 November, Sohar Freezone signed six land-lease agreements with planned investment exceeding RO63 million over more than 440,000 square metres. The EW Partners-backed Sohar Automotive & Advanced Industries Park accounts for approximately RO38 million on a 317,000-square-metre site, with an initial approximately 180,000 square metres of manufacturing plants, workshops and warehouses. Its investment is included in the six-agreement total and must not be double counted.
items.why_it_matters: 明确的土地租赁与分期开发方案具有工业建设供应链价值，但尚无独立建设采购公告。
items.why_it_matters_en: The signed land lease and phased industrial development may generate construction demand, though individual procurement packages have not been announced.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注厂房、钢结构、机电、仓储及中国汽车产业链供应合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track factory buildings, steel structures, MEP, logistics facilities and Chinese automotive supply-chain partnerships.
items.stage: 土地租赁协议已签／建设规划

items.title: 阿曼启动首个放射性药品制造项目Nucleus Oman
items.title_en: Oman launches its first radiopharmaceutical manufacturing project, Nucleus Oman
items.summary: 阿曼投资局与Oryx Isotopes宣布成立Nucleus Oman合资项目，并与卫生部建立长期公私合作模式，规划放射性药品生产、辐射校准、研究开发及培训设施，提升核医学诊断和治疗药品本地供应。公告未披露建设工程金额。
items.summary_en: Oman Investment Authority and Oryx Isotopes launched Nucleus Oman, a joint venture under a long-term public-private partnership with the Ministry of Health. It will develop integrated radiopharmaceutical manufacturing, radiation calibration, research and training facilities for nuclear medicine. No construction budget was disclosed.
items.why_it_matters: 专业医药设施存在建设与设备潜力，供应商须满足特殊医疗及辐射安全要求。
items.why_it_matters_en: Specialised medical manufacturing may generate facility and equipment opportunities subject to strict medical and radiation-safety requirements.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注专业厂房、洁净设施、医疗设备与技术合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor specialist facilities, cleanrooms, medical equipment and technical partnerships.

items.title: 迪拜Al Khaleej Street 1650米隧道正式通车
items.title_en: Dubai opens 1,650-metre Al Khaleej Street Tunnel in Deira
items.sector: 城市道路及交通基础设施
items.summary: 迪拜道路与交通管理局11月8日启用位于Deira的Al Khaleej Street Tunnel，隧道长1650米、双向各三车道，总通行能力约每小时12000辆，属于Al Shindagha Corridor开发计划的一部分。该消息为既有工程启用，非新增工程招标。
items.summary_en: Dubai's Roads and Transport Authority opened the 1,650-metre Al Khaleej Street Tunnel in Deira on 8 November. The tunnel has three lanes in each direction and a combined capacity of approximately 12,000 vehicles per hour, as part of the Al Shindagha Corridor Development Project. The announcement marks completion of existing works rather than a new tender.
items.why_it_matters: 重点是城市交通设施落地，后续维护和交通系统服务可能有机会。
items.why_it_matters_en: The opening improves urban connectivity, while maintenance and transport systems may offer subsequent service opportunities.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注交通设施、道路运维及后续沿线配套采购。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track traffic systems, road maintenance and follow-on procurement along the corridor.

items.title: 迪拜DEWA与Dell Technologies探索智能电网及变电站升级
items.title_en: Dubai DEWA and Dell Technologies explore smart-grid and substation modernisation
items.sector: 智能电网与企业数字化
items.summary: 迪拜水电局DEWA与Dell Technologies于11月8日签署合作备忘录，研究提升智能电网和变电站的网络及运营韧性、边缘计算、人工智能及数据管理，并探索参考设计与试点项目。尚未公布具体采购合同。
items.summary_en: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority and Dell Technologies signed an MoU on 8 November to explore smart-grid and substation modernisation, cyber and operational resilience, edge computing, artificial intelligence and data management, including potential reference designs and pilots. No specific procurement award was disclosed.
items.why_it_matters: 属于数字基础设施技术合作而非新建变电站EPC项目。
items.why_it_matters_en: This is a digital-infrastructure partnership rather than an awarded substation construction EPC project.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注智能电网、AI系统集成、数据管理及技术供应合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track smart-grid solutions, AI systems integration, data management and technology supply partnerships.

items.title: 阿曼马斯喀特Ruwi商业区29万平方米城市更新项目完成约40%
items.title_en: Oman's Ruwi business district revitalisation project reaches around 40% completion
items.summary: 马斯喀特市政当局11月8日披露Ruwi商业区更新项目已完成约40%，覆盖逾29万平方米，建设内容包括景观美化、260余棵树木、290余套街道照明设施、约两公里步道、跑步骑行路线、跨河人行桥及公共服务设施。属于既有市政工程进展。
items.summary_en: Muscat Municipality reported on 8 November that its Ruwi Business District revitalisation scheme is approximately 40% complete, covering over 290,000 square metres. Works include landscaping, more than 260 trees, over 290 street lights, a roughly two-kilometre walkway, running and cycling tracks, a pedestrian bridge and public amenities. This is progress on existing municipal works.
items.why_it_matters: 施工已开展，剩余工程和后续维护是否对外采购仍需核实。
items.why_it_matters_en: Construction is underway, while remaining work packages and future maintenance procurement require verification.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注景观、照明、公共设施、建材及维护服务。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Monitor landscaping, lighting, street furniture, building materials and maintenance services.
